episodes.199015: A weak frontal boundary stretched to the northeast from southeast Missouri across southern Illinois. Along and south of it, a narrow band of lower 50 degree dewpoints supported very meager instability (CAPE of 250-500 J/kg). A lone storm develop around 2 PM in an area of enhanced surface convergence over northwest Jackson county. It gradually intensified as it moved along the boundary. It produced copious amounts of small hail that covered the ground in northwest Hamilton county, and then reached its strongest intensity, producing quarter size hail, as it reached Mt Carmel just before 7 PM.
episodes.199016: A weak frontal boundary was located across southern Illinois and into southwest Indiana. Along and south of the boundary, a narrow ribbon of dewpoints in the lower 50s supported very meager instability (CAPE = 250 J/kg). A lone storm moved along the boundary, passed through Mt Carmel Illinois, and then into northern Gibson County. The storm pulsed up to produce quarter size hail just southwest of Hazleton and then quickly diminished, as it moved into Pike County.
